name: Memory
description: Persistent agent memory — save, search, and delete memory entries across sessions.
author: my-agent

tools.name: save_memory
tools.description: Save a new memory entry to the persistent memory store. Use layer 1 for permanent identity facts, layer 2 for user preferences and skills, layer 3 for time-sensitive project context (requires ttl_days).

content.description: The factual text to remember. Be concise and specific.

tags.description: Keyword tags for search and categorization (e.g. ["typescript", "preference"])

ttl_days.description: Time-to-live in days. Required for layer 3. Typical values: 7 (sprint), 30 (project), 90 (quarter).

tools.name: search_memory
tools.description: Search persistent memory entries. Use at the start of a new topic to check for existing relevant context. Returns entries sorted by most recently updated.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring match against entry content.

tags.description: Return entries that have ANY of these tags.

layer.description: Filter to a specific layer (1, 2, or 3). Omit to search all layers.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 20).

tools.name: delete_memory
tools.description: Delete a memory entry by its ID. Use when a memory is outdated or incorrect.

id.description: UUID of the memory entry to delete.
